timeUnit: modeled seconds: compressed simulation steps, not bedside time
method: Identical plans (src/features/cardiohelp-ecmo/test-support/causalTrajectories.ts) replayed through the reducer on the baseline tree (origin/main 9fbdbddc) and on the repaired tree. Each row is [label, ...columns]. "load" is t=0 as loaded; an action row is read at an unchanged simulation time, apart from clock rows ("tick"). Paths: A time only, B assessment only, C intended treatment, D harmful or ineffective path. VA "spo2" is the right-arm reading.
